entities.name: Query CoaBC-like protein
observations: 422 aa sequence; estimated mass 44.9 kDa and theoretical pI 8.51.
Moderate homology support for bifunctional CoaBC: top reviewed homolog Q7MPS9 has 46.4% identity over 94.1% query coverage (E=1.35e-110).
Predicted Pfam domains: Flavoprotein PF02441 at residues 18–198; DFP PF04127 at residues 203–415.
Homolog annotations associate CoaBC with phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activities; exact function remains inferred from homology.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC homologs catalyze consecutive pathway steps: CTP-dependent ligation of cysteine to 4'-phosphopantothenate, then decarboxylation of 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine to 4'-phosphopantetheine.
Homolog references report Mg2+ and FMN cofactors; these are not experimentally confirmed for the query sequence.
